# List Cloudflare Workers Builds tokens (`list_workers_build_tokens`)

MCP tool `cloudflare_listWorkersBuildTokens` · scope `access_provider_connections` · write

Lists the Workers Builds token records in the Cloudflare account connected to the selected Samebase
organization. The result contains each token's non-secret name and Workers Builds UUID. It also
returns lastUsedBuildTokenUuid when that organization default remains in the current list, or null
when it is unavailable. It never returns the token secret or the underlying Cloudflare user API
token id. For managed app creation, use an available lastUsedBuildTokenUuid without asking. If there
is no available last-used UUID, use one result or ask the user to choose by displayed name and UUID
when several results exist. Pass that exact UUID in the required cloudflareBuildTokenUuid field.
Only when this current list is empty, pass explicit null in that required field. The managed run
then creates the GitHub repository and Convex project but no Cloudflare Worker. Report Cloudflare
setup as pending and give the user https://samebase.com/docs/cloudflare-setup.

Manual Worker creation and Workers Builds configuration require one exact UUID from a non-empty
current list. When the list is empty, do not call those writes. Use current repository inventory to
select the next action:

- For a managed plan with a null build token, no attached Worker, and the exact planned Convex
  project attached, give the user https://samebase.com/docs/cloudflare-setup. After the user creates
  the first account token and deletes the temporary Worker, list tokens again and call
  repository_cloudflare_createWorker with a current exact UUID. Reread inventory, then call
  repository_cloudflare_rotateConvexDeployKeysForWorkersBuilds with the new Worker and attached
  project.
- When a Worker is already attached, keep it. After the user completes token setup, list tokens
  again and call repository_cloudflare_configureWorkersBuildsForGitHub for that attachment. Do not
  create another Worker.
- For another manual repository, complete token setup, list tokens again, and continue only with the
  action that matches the user's request and current inventory. Worker creation does not install
  Convex deploy keys.

Never pass null to a manual Worker or Builds write.

## Arguments

- `githubOwnerLogin` (string, required): GitHub owner login for the Samebase organization whose
  Cloudflare account must be read.

## Returns

JSON Schema for the tool's `structuredContent`:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "accountId": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "lastUsedBuildTokenUuid": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "tokens": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "uuid": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "name": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": ["uuid", "name"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    }
  },
  "required": ["accountId", "lastUsedBuildTokenUuid", "tokens"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
